findings.title: Lab job API server and lab-vpn scripts have no automated test in CI
evidence: tests/ covers deterministic_checks, full_domain, lib_findings, publish_audit, repo_inventory only
.github/workflows/pack-tests.yml:35 runs `unittest discover -s tests` (no lab server test)
findings.impact: Regressions in the auth/sync/run HTTP surface would not be caught before a lab is re-provisioned.
findings.recommendation: Add a unit test around Handler dispatch with a temp ROOT, or a lab smoke test in the preflight.

report: Reviewed `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/LAB_ARCHITECTURE.md`, the tools/ tree and `.github/workflows/`. Confirmed the driver -> `_domains` payload -> aggregate -> check_run pipeline and the lab job API topology.
